synthesizedFacts.fact: Non-itchy red marks on the skin can be caused by changes in blood vessels, inflammation deeper within the skin, or bleeding under the skin.
Pityriasis rosea is characterized by a herald patch followed by a widespread rash, which can be itchy but is not always.
Bowen's disease presents as a slow-growing, red, scaly patch on the skin and is considered pre-cancerous.
Ringworm typically causes a red ring with raised, scaly edges and is often itchy, but not all circular rashes are ringworm.
